title: Cornish Scones
description: Scones - What else did you expect?
body:
This mod adds Scones, cooking utensils like a mixing bowl, as well as some new ingredients, such as vanilla and lemon, to make scones the Cornish way.

The mod IS currently survival-friendly.

## Discord
If you want to see sneak-peeks or interact with a growing community, join my Discord! Also report any bugs you find there.
